title: Engineering Gelation Kinetics in Living Silk Hydrogels by Differential Dynamic Microscopy Microrheology and Machine Learning
summary: Mapped gel-time regime boundaries in four-dimensional enzymatically crosslinked silk hydrogel formulations and identified formulations gelling within 5–15 min while retaining similar E. coli fluorophore production in the tested subset. Automated DDM gel-time estimates were compared with traditional multiple-particle-tracking methods; formulation outcomes were experimentally measured and bacterial protein production was assessed by confocal microscopy. Evidence is limited to the tested parameter space and illustrative target window.
ai_technology: Bayesian machine-learning planner selected formulations under uncertainty to accelerate gel-time regime discovery after an initial human-planning round; it guided experiments rather than merely analyzing a completed dataset.
